fusions.name: Stitch Work
fusions.desc: Bites for 7 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You hold up to 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Seam Leap
fusions.desc: Leaps at an enemy from range, dealing 32 damage that ignores armour, up to 2 times as much at its maximum range.

fusions.name: Find the Gap
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Fang
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a second bite flies to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
